versions.changelog:
Initial release of moark-image-gen — generate high-quality images from text descriptions using Gitee AI.

- Introduces a script-based workflow for generating images based on user prompts.
- Supports multiple image sizes and negative prompt filtering.
- Requires a GiteeAI API key (GITEEAI_API_KEY) or direct argument.
- Automatically extracts and displays generated image URLs in markdown format.
- Returns image preview and repeats user's description for clarity.
